# Examples

The examples from [pele.run](https://pele.run/examples), rendered by
zensical-pele. Each page has the diagram and its Markdown.

- [Block](block.md): Show blocks in a grid that you arrange yourself.
- [C4](c4.md): Show a software system as people, systems, containers, and components.
- [Class](class.md): Show classes, their members, and the relationships between them.
- [Entity relationship](er.md): Show entities, their attributes, and the relationships between them.
- [Event modeling](eventmodeling.md): Show how commands, events, and views change a system over time.
- [Flowchart](flowchart.md): Show the steps and decisions in a process.
- [Gantt](gantt.md): Show the tasks of a project on a timeline.
- [Git graph](git.md): Show commits, branches, and merges.
- [Kanban](kanban.md): Show tasks in columns by status.
- [Mindmap](mindmap.md): Show ideas branching out from a central topic.
- [Packet](packet.md): Show the fields of a network packet.
- [Pie](pie.md): Show the parts of a whole.
- [Quadrant chart](quadrant.md): Plot items on two axes that divide the chart into four sections.
- [Requirement](requirement.md): Show requirements and how they relate to each other and to the elements that satisfy them.
- [Sankey](sankey.md): Show flows between nodes, with widths proportional to quantity.
- [Sequence](sequence.md): Show the messages that participants exchange over time.
- [State](state.md): Show the states of a system and the transitions between them.
- [Timeline](timeline.md): Show events in chronological order.
- [User journey](journey.md): Show the steps of a task and how satisfying each one is.
- [XY chart](xychart.md): Plot data as bars and lines on two axes.
- [Agentflow](agentflow.md): Show the tasks of AI agents and how work passes between them.
- [Architecture](architecture.md): Show services and the connections between them.
- [Cynefin](cynefin.md): Sort items into the five domains of the Cynefin framework.
- [Ishikawa](ishikawa.md): Show the causes that contribute to a problem.
- [Radar](radar.md): Compare values across several axes.
- [Railroad](railroad.md): Show the syntax of a grammar.
- [Swimlane](swimlane.md): Show a process divided by who performs each step.
- [Tree view](treeview.md): Show a hierarchy, such as files and folders.
- [Treemap](treemap.md): Show hierarchical data as nested rectangles, sized by value.
- [Use case](usecase.md): Show actors and the goals they reach with a system.
- [Venn](venn.md): Show sets and where they overlap.
- [Wardley map](wardley.md): Plot components by their visibility to the user and their stage of evolution.
